# Patient Diagnoses

## Primary Diagnoses

**Atrial Septal Defect (ASD) - Surgically Repaired**
- Secundum ASD measuring 1.1 x 1.4 cm, discovered December 2019
- Failed percutaneous closure with 22mm Amplatzer device (February 12, 2020) - device embolized to aortic arch
- Device retrieved February 27, 2020
- Definitive open surgical port-access repair completed July 27, 2020

**Cryptogenic Stroke (December 1, 2019)**
- Presented with transient right-sided hemiparesis, numbness, and dysarthria lasting 45 seconds
- MRI: small lacunar infarct in left posterior frontal lobe
- ROPE Score 10 (88% probability stroke due to PFO/ASD)
- Etiology: paradoxical embolism through ASD

**Recurrent Pulmonary Embolism**
- First episode (February 2020): right lower lobe segmental PE, provoked by ASD device
- Second episode (September 2020): central left lower lobar PE with subsegmental emboli in right lower lobe and left upper lobe, unprovoked
- Currently on indefinite anticoagulation with Rivaroxaban 20 mg daily

**Chronic Urticaria**
- Onset February 13, 2020 (post-ASD closure procedure)
- Confirmed trigger: aspirin allergy/sensitivity
- Managed with Cetirizine 10 mg twice daily

## Secondary Diagnoses

**Secondary Hypercoagulable State**
- Extensive workup negative for inherited thrombophilias (Factor V Leiden, prothrombin gene mutation, lupus anticoagulant, anticardiolipin antibodies, Protein C/S deficiency, Antithrombin III)
- Requires lifelong anticoagulation due to recurrent unprovoked PE

**Allergic Rhinitis** - chronic condition

**Lipoma** - left lateral chest wall (5.3 x 1.1 x 3.8 cm), surgically excised April 3, 2024

## Formal ICD-10 Codes Documented
- Q21.1: Atrial Septal Defect, Unspecified
- Z87.74: History of Amplatzer Atrial Septal Defect Closure
